title.narrative: SLGP EC RSF Ukraine OTP Bank and Leasing

description.narrative: The most significant expected project-level outcome for the Project is access to finance for SMEs, particularly for WSMEs. Beyond the project-level outcome, IFC anticipates that the investment will support resilience amongst the SME market in Ukraine. IFC expects that the Project will generate changes in the SME market by demonstrating that, when approached with the right strategies, tools, and models, SMEs can be a commercially attractive and a viable asset class.

The proposed investment consists of unfunded risk sharing facilities (RSFs) with JSC OTP Bank and OTP Leasing LLC (partner FIs) in an aggregate amount of up to 60 million, where IFCs risk participation will be up 30 million, or 50% of the RSFs (the Project). The Project is processed under IFCs Small Loans Guarantee Program (SLGP EC/PSW), a programmatic approach to de-risk and scale up financing to small and medium enterprises (SMEs) in Ukraine and other eligible countries. SLGP EC/PSW is supported by the European Commissions (EC) European Fund for Sustainable Development. The Project will also be potentially supported by the Women Entrepreneurs Finance Initiative (We-Fi), subject to further approvals and achieving agreed targets, in the form of a performance-based incentive (PBI) to incentivize the partner FIs increased financing of women-owned SMEs in Ukraine.
